Process

No guesswork. A system built for results.

  1. AuditI dig into your accounts, your competitors and your website to find what’s working, what isn’t, and where customers are slipping away.
  2. StrategyWe lock in your goals, your audience and the three or four content pillars that will make you the go-to name in your space.
  3. CreateI write and design every post, carousel and reel in your voice, and every one ends with a clear next step for the reader.
  4. PublishYour content goes out on schedule, every week, even when you’re too busy to think about social media.
  5. ReportEvery month you see exactly what’s working: reach, engagement, follower growth and enquiries, plus the plan for next month.

About me

Most social media managers stop at the post. I follow the click.

Anyone can make a pretty post. The real question is what happens next. If your content wins attention but your website loses the visitor, the campaign has failed. Because I also design and build websites, I fix both ends.

I’ve run social media, design and web for a cannabis accounting firm, a Texas road contractor, a facility management company and a youth-led health nonprofit with 21,300 Instagram followers. Wildly different audiences. The same job every time: make the brand the obvious choice, and make getting in touch effortless.

I’m based in Nigeria and work remotely with clients across time zones. You get a clear weekly rhythm, so you always know what’s going out and how it performed.

Your next customer is scrolling right now. Let’s make them stop.

Tell me about your business and where you want to grow. I’ll reply with a clear plan for your feed, your brand and your website.

Farier Consulting

Turning a Texas road contractor into the safe bet for city contracts.

Farier Consulting is a licensed, bonded and insured US general contractor for commercial construction, road construction and repair, renovation and site development. Much of its work is won through public bids, so the website has to earn trust with city engineers and procurement officers quickly.

Visit farierconsultingllc.com
Industry
Construction and government contracting
Market
Texas, United States
Built with
HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Services
Social media, graphics, website

Social media

Contracts are won by trust, so social content works like a running portfolio: completed projects, on-time handovers and practical expertise, aimed at the city engineers and procurement teams who award the work. It uses the same indigo and cyan look as the website, so the brand is recognisable wherever a buyer meets it.

Website

The homepage opens on one promise set over a deep indigo construction scene: “We build it. We pave it. We hand it over on schedule.” The company’s track record sits right underneath. I turned a single page into a multipage site built to be found by the people who award contracts:

  • An insights hub with three in-depth articles on asphalt overlay versus reconstruction, ADA compliance for city sidewalks and budgeting for downtown parking lots, each grounded in completed projects in Sealy, Glen Rose and Giddings. These double as long-form material for social posts.
  • Structured data, page titles and descriptions on every page, plus a sitemap, so search engines understand what the company does and where.
  • A bid request form that delivers straight to the company inbox, with spam filtering and a fallback so no lead is lost.

Graphics

I also designed the A3FS landing page, which brings FACTSTX, Farier Consulting and Farier Residential Management under one umbrella brand.

Social media

Most facility companies compete on price and look it. Opulent’s social content positions it as the premium, accountable option, carrying the “We notice everything” voice and a restrained, premium look, so a property manager who meets the brand on social sees the same company when they reach the website.

9:41●●●
  • Reels-firstShort-form video leads the feed, the format Instagram pushes hardest
